brief: Walk forward from a standing start (about 3.85 m, five steps or so) and stop, feet together, in front of the person standing ahead: head within 1.1 m of his head (surface to surface) by 4.9 s, never closer than 50 cm.
notes: Fighter 2 stands still facing the hero. The walk template (templates/walk.json) is one way: its note cites step length 0.415 of height and cadence 105 steps/min. 30 fps.
